items.title: NMC health settlement drags Bank of Baroda Q1 net profit down 72%
items.description: Bank of Baroda's June-quarter profit fell 72% due to a large settlement payment. Other income also declined, impacting the bank's overall financial performance for the period. Shriram Finance reported a 60% increase in its standalone net profit for the first quarter. Bank of India's net profit jumped 36%, and it seeks foreign currency deposits.

items.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q1 Results: Net profit up 37% to Rs 796 crore
items.description: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 37% net profit increase for Q1.  Net interest income also saw a significant 31.8% year-on-year rise.  The lender has fixed July 31, 2026, as the record date.  This date will determine shareholders eligible for a final dividend.  The dividend, if declared, will be at the upcoming Annual General Meeting.

items.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q1 net profit jumps 37% to Rs 796 crore
items.description: AU Small Finance Bank recorded a 37% surge in Q1 net profit to Rs 796 crore, driven by robust loan growth and improved asset quality. Gross NPA dropped to 2.1%, while net interest income grew 32% to Rs 2,695 crore.

items.title: IDFC First Bank Q1 Results: Profit shoots up 132% YoY to record Rs 1,075 crore; NII jumps 21%
items.description: IDFC First Bank Q1 Results: IDFC FIRST Bank on Saturday reported its highest-ever quarterly profit after tax (PAT) of Rs 1,075 crore for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, marking a 132.4% year-on-year increase from Rs 463 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
